mathematical_derivation.positive_conditions: rho>0, mu>0, K3D=lambda+2mu/3>0; plane-strain strains form a subspace, so the restricted energy is positive.
mathematical_derivation.negative_lambda_interval: sqrt(4/3)<Vp/Vs<sqrt(2) gives positive 3D bulk while lambda<0.
mathematical_derivation.classification: Analytic derivation; not a numerical stability test.

native_source_findings: read_materials admits negative Poisson ratio inside its [-1,0.5] range and emits an informational rare-material message.
The isotropic P-SV constitutive force branch forms lambda from rho*Vp^2-2mu and uses lambda, lambda+2mu and mu algebraically. No sqrt(lambda) occurs in that branch.
The reviewed external-model domain check uses Vs to classify acoustic versus elastic material; it does not classify by lambda sign.
check_grid uses Vp and sqrt(mu/rho) for wave-speed guidance.

guard_design.opt_in_positive_bulk_test: Vp^2>4Vs^2/3; existing finite positive solid Vp/Vs/rho checks retained

remaining_required_evidence: Actual native negative-lambda synthetic unit baseline, recorded forward, finite nonzero traces and measured f0/DT guidance.
Fresh L2 data VJP and informative Vp-only model dot directions at declared epsilons with dVs=dRho=0.
Actual GLL rho and mu agree with fixed true fields for initial, target and perturbed runs; retain private native SAVE_MODEL exports.
status: Physics and reviewed native source support the explicit opt-in design; numerical acceptance remains pending.
